standard_prerequisites.name: Coset covering
standard_prerequisites.statement: The family is contained in the union of T cosets, each determined by prescribing C(f) images.

standard_prerequisites.name: Representative lemma
standard_prerequisites.statement: Two members with equal value admit representatives meeting exactly in the intersection of their certificates.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is used to place members in cosets.

standard_prerequisites.name: Structure of a covered family
standard_prerequisites.statement: An m-covered family gives every member a certificate of size m plus one.
standard_prerequisites.use: It bounds the number of cosets needed.

core_obligations: Apply the covering lemma to place the family inside a first coset and count what is left outside it (source lines 618-620).
Iterate the argument on the leftover part, each time using the representative lemma and the structure lemma to bound the size of the remaining piece (source lines 620-642).
Telescope the bound over the iterations to obtain the stated number T of cosets (source lines 642-650).

proof_roadmap.step: Cover by a first coset and bound the remainder.
Iterate the covering and structure bounds.
Sum the bounds to obtain T.

difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the author's labelled lemma at source lines 608-616: for a 2-intersecting family of permutations whose characteristic function has degree at most two and common certificate size at most n minus two, the family is contained in the union of at most T cosets of size equal to the certificate size, with T given by an explicit recursion. The proof (source lines 617-650) is an iteration that the statement hides entirely: the covering lemma gives a first coset containing the whole family, the part left outside is again a 2-intersecting family to which the representative and structure lemmas apply, and repeating the argument while summing the bounds produces the recursion for T. The statement records only the covering and the value of T.
